title: Does Pinnacle offer Occupational Therapy services on holidays?
metaTitle: Holiday Schedule for Occupational Therapy - Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Get information about the schedule and availability of Occupational Therapy services at Pinnacle Blooms Network during holidays.
html: At Pinnacle Blooms Network, we understand the importance of continuity in therapy, but our operational hours do vary across our different centers. Hence, it would be best to reach out to your nearest Pinnacle center or connect with our helpline to get the precise details about therapy sessions during holidays. We're here to support you and your child every step of the way!
